name: SnowBallFight V2
summary:
Overview
Welcome to SnowballFightBeta v2, the exhilarating new version of the fan-favorite game SnowballFightBeta! Step into the frosty world where you, a courageous snowman, must master the art of gorilla locomotion to outmaneuver your opponents. This game takes inspiration from the beloved Gorilla Tag series, blending its unique movement mechanics with the thrill of a classic snowball fight.
